transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?
I’ve been feeling really down and persistently depressed for the past eight months. It’s a constant, heavy sadness that just won't seem to go away.
Have you experienced any periods during these past eight months where your mood was significantly worse, or have you felt this same level of 'heavy sadness' every single day without any breaks?
It has been this same level of heavy sadness every single day. There haven't been any breaks or periods where I felt even slightly better.

latest_inference.note: Previously the candidates were [Major Depressive Disorder, Persistent Depressive Disorder].
